CompTIA Data+ DA0-002 Practice Exam
Original practice questions aligned to DA0-002 V2 objectives
Time: 90:00
Three separate study experiences. Learn Mode uses a dedicated 500-question instructional bank (100 per domain) and lets you choose 1–100 questions from one domain or all five. Exam Mode contains two fixed, distinct 90-item exams; neither exam reuses Learn Mode questions, and Exam A and Exam B do not share questions with each other. Each exam contains 84 higher-rigor multiple-choice/multi-select items plus 6 embedded PBQs while preserving the official domain mix. PBQ Challenge remains a separate 15-scenario advanced workout.
Scoring: Custom Learn Mode sessions report raw mastery only, because a short or single-domain lesson should not be treated like a certification exam. Exam Mode reports raw mastery, weighted mastery, and an estimated 100–900 practice scaled score with 720 as the practice benchmark. This remains a study estimate—not CompTIA's proprietary scoring formula.

Learn Mode

Choose the number of questions and the domain you want to study. Feedback appears immediately after each answer with a beginner-friendly explanation and a reason for every choice.

Exam Mode

Two fixed 90-item forms with a 90-minute timer and no correctness feedback until the end. Exam A and Exam B are mutually unique and are separate from the Learn bank.

PBQ Challenge

Two deliberately difficult 15-scenario forms—3 PBQs per domain, 4 scored tasks each. Use Form B for a fresh repeat without memorized scenarios.

Learn Mode draws only from its 500-question teaching bank. When “All 5 domains” is selected, the session approximates the official DA0-002 domain weighting; choosing one domain uses only that domain’s 100-question pool. Exam A and Exam B are fixed 90-item forms with disjoint MCQ and PBQ content, so learning-session memorization does not inflate an Exam Mode score.

Learn Mode

Build a learning session

Choose what you want to study. You will get the explanation immediately after submitting each answer, including why the correct choice works and why every other choice does not.

500-question Learn pool: 100 unique instructional questions per domain. For All 5 domains, the question mix follows the official weighting as closely as whole-question counts allow. Learn questions are separate from both Exam A and Exam B.
